steps.t: Locate the Flood Access Tunnel under the Red Lake Balcony
steps.go: Head to Red Lakes Balcony and drop below it. The large tunnel mouth sits underneath.

steps.t: Find the intake to the District's Water Supply
steps.go: Walk through the tunnel to the shallow, murky pool at the far end. No need to go further.

steps.t: Sample the water
steps.go: Interact with the tube lying in the water, then extract.
steps.show: Use the tube in the water.

steps.t: Go to the Hydroponic Dome Complex
steps.pin: Go to the Hydroponic Dome Complex
steps.go: Make for the cluster of domes on Dam Battlegrounds.

steps.t: Access the data archive in one of the domes
steps.pin: Access the data archive in one of the domes
steps.go: Enter any of the marked domes and use the terminal inside. Any dome with the archive works.

steps.t: Upload the data to the computer terminal in any Field Depot
steps.pin: Upload the data to the computer terminal
steps.go: Find a Field Depot (trailer with a satellite tower) and use the desk computer inside.

steps.t: Search 2 containers in the Raider Camp beneath the Parking Garage
steps.pin: Search 2 containers in the Raider Camp
steps.go: Buried City map. Rappel down the elevator shaft in the Parking Garage corner and open the two containers at the bottom.

steps.t: Search for anything significant in the South Swamp Outpost
steps.go: Go to the big building on the west side of the outpost and interact with the papers on the table.
steps.show: Check the papers on the table.

steps.t: Search for anything significant in Bilguun's Hideout, next to the Container Storage
steps.go: Spaceport map. Climb the tall ladder on the high east side of Container Storage to the trailer and use the documents.

steps.t: Search 2 containers in the Departure Building's exam rooms
steps.go: Spaceport map. Work along the Departure Building walls to the labelled exam rooms and open two containers.

steps.t: Search 3 containers in the Hospital
steps.go: Buried City map. Any three containers inside the Hospital count.

steps.t: Search 2 containers in the Research & Administration building's medical room
steps.go: Take the zipline up the elevator shaft, turn right down the hallway and look for the medical cross signs.

steps.t: Reach Victory Ridge
steps.go: Head for the First Wave battle site near the West Broken Bridge at the north of the map. It is not labelled on the map.

steps.t: Find the old EMP trap
steps.go: Look for the tall pole wrapped in wire in the middle of the ridge and interact at its base.

steps.t: Disable the first power switch
steps.go: Climb the small cliff near the trap and flip the switch on top.

steps.t: Disable the second power switch
steps.go: Go to the crumbled building and climb the boxes to the balcony switch.

steps.t: Disable the third power switch
steps.go: Spot the bright yellow box with a long trailing cable and switch it off.

steps.t: Shut down the EMP trap
steps.go: Return to the pole and deactivate the trap.

steps.t: On Dam Battlegrounds, visit the Locked Room in the Water Treatment Control building
steps.go: Take the Dam Surveillance key from Celeste first. Find the door with a small red light near the building's south entrance and unlock it.

steps.t: On Spaceport, scope out the rocket thrusters outside the Rocket Assembly
steps.go: Spaceport map. In the yard outside Rocket Assembly, walk around and step inside both big thrusters.

steps.t: On Buried City, visit the barricaded area on floor 6 of the Space Travel Building
steps.go: Buried City map. Climb the rope to the roof, take the stairwell down one floor, then breach the barricaded door at the hallway end.

steps.t: Reach the hallowed grounds by the Scrap Yard
steps.go: Head to the First Wave site beside the Scrap Yard on Dam Battlegrounds.

steps.t: Search for a compass near the broken-down vehicles
steps.go: Squeeze into the narrow gap between the wrecked vehicles and search.

steps.t: Search for the video tape near the cylindrical containers
steps.go: A little on from the compass, search the small box in front of the two big cylinders.

steps.t: Search for the old field rations in the Raider camp
steps.go: Follow the path to the abandoned Raider camp and search the box inside the trailer.

steps.t: Deliver First Wave Compass to Tian Wen
steps.go: Extract and hand the compass to Tian Wen in Speranza.

steps.t: Deliver the First Wave Tape to Tian Wen
steps.go: Hand the tape to Tian Wen in Speranza.

steps.t: Deliver First Wave Rations to Tian Wen
steps.go: Hand the rations to Tian Wen in Speranza.

steps.t: Reach Victory Ridge
steps.go: Head to the First Wave battle site near the West Broken Bridge at the north of Dam Battlegrounds.

steps.t: Retrieve the battle plans from the hideout under the broken highway
steps.pin: Echoes of Victory Ridge - Battle Plans
steps.go: Find the broken highway and search the box stashed beneath it, then pick up the plans.

steps.t: Deliver Major Aiva's Patch to Celeste
steps.go: Extract and hand the patch to Celeste in Speranza.
